name: Mr. C Miami - Coconut Grove
positioning: Nautical-inspired Cipriani family hotel in Coconut Grove, Miami, with views of Biscayne Bay
best_for: Couples and solo travelers wanting a Coconut Grove base
Guests who want a guests-only rooftop pool with bay views plus beach access on Miami Beach

facts.text: The hotel is in Coconut Grove, Miami, with views of Biscayne Bay and the Coconut Grove skyline.
The hotel is run by the Cipriani family, with brothers Ignazio and Maggio Cipriani leading it.
Arquitectonica designed the building, inspired by the pier-like Stiltsville structures and by nautical elements from Venice.
The lobby has nautical, vintage-inspired details such as velvet seating and a lacquered wood desk.
Every room has a private balcony, some with views of the bay.
The rooftop pool has views of Biscayne Bay, Coconut Grove, Brickell and South Beach.
BeAtala Wellness Spa offers personalized treatments, innovative therapies and holistic practices.
The hotel has a fully equipped fitness center.
Bellini is the rooftop restaurant, serving classic Italian cuisine with views of Biscayne Bay.
Il Giardino offers relaxed breakfasts, lunches and cocktails in a garden-inspired setting.
The hotel is down the street from the CocoWalk outdoor mall.
The hotel has indoor and outdoor event venues overlooking Biscayne Bay.

highlights.text: The facade has porthole windows, and sail-like tarps separate each balcony, a nod to Coconut Grove's sailboat culture.
The rooftop pool is reserved for hotel guests and has cabanas.
Guests get private beach access on Miami Beach in partnership with Boucher Brothers, with two reserved chairs and towels; more beach amenities and watersports are available on request.
Rooms were designed by Martin Brudnizki, with walnut furniture, blue-tiled walk-in showers and toiletries custom-made in Italy.
All guests get a complimentary Bellini at check-in.

considerations.text: The hotel is not on or near a beach; South Beach is a short drive away.
The hotel suits couples and single travelers best; families can use suites with pull-out couches or adjoining rooms.
WhataHotel notes premium pricing that reflects the luxury positioning.
